newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese troops seize 488 kg of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese troops seize 488 kg of hashish.

text.p: Lebanese soldiers have seized 488 kg (1,074 lb) of hashish in northern Lebanon, police sources said on Tuesday.
They said the drugs were found in plastic bags in a cave near the northern village of Alma. The haul was worth about $200,000, the sources added.
Last month, Syrian forces seized 500 kg (1,100 lb) of hashish in eastern Lebanon's Syrian-policed Bekaa Valley.

Lebanese and Syrian forces have since 1992 drastically reduced cannabis and opium poppy cultivation in Lebanon, especially in the Bekaa Valley, a centre for the lucrative drugs trade during the 1975-90 civil war.
